plugin.name: eForm Studio
plugin.description: Five roles for AIMES CustomDev customization: coordinator, requirements/prototypes, development, testing and deployment. Confirmed specifications lead to real engineering and dev test acceptance; prototypes are not implementation, signatures/audits are conditional, and production deployment is out of scope.
agent.eform.name: Coordinator
agent.eform.description: Preserves the @eform entry: environment preflight, user interaction, scope decisions, coordination and assistance. Separates verified facts from unknown project rules.
agent.requirements.name: Requirements & Prototypes
agent.requirements.description: Clarifies requirements and field-value logic; parses source form attachments and produces presentation prototypes when needed. Materials feed requirements closure, not replace engineering.
agent.developer.name: Developer
agent.developer.description: Implements frontend, backend, APIs, configuration, SQL and behavior tests from confirmed requirements and the actual CustomDev contract, without importing Workshop or legacy demo assumptions.
agent.tester.name: Tester
agent.tester.description: Selects risk-based black-box/white-box tests and builds; uses computer-use where available and authorized, records gaps, and verifies the complete dev integration package.
agent.deployer.name: Test Deployer
agent.deployer.description: Dev test servers only: verifies artifacts, paths, target service and rollback before updating/restarting and supporting acceptance; provides artifacts and instructions when access or facts are missing. No production deployment.
team.studio.name: eForm Studio
team.studio.description: Five-role AIMES CustomDev team: preflight → requirements → development → local tests → skipped validation placeholder → dev integration package → test-server acceptance. Skills are plugin-shared and invoked by responsibility and trigger.
